# My Little House Play School

> A warm, play-based childcare centre in Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia, for children aged 3 months to 9 years. Officially registered as My Little House Playschool Childcare Centre (Taska Rumah Kecilku); operating since 2011.

## Key facts

- Name: My Little House Play School (registered: My Little House Playschool Childcare Centre / Taska Rumah Kecilku)
- Location: No. 40, Grand Height, Jalan Johari Sunam, 97000 Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia
- Contact: WhatsApp or call Ms Siti at +60 14-887 9930 (Monday–Friday)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30am – 6:00pm
- Founded: 2011. Principal & Founder: Puan Siti Fatihah Binti Mohamad (bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education, 22 years' experience since 2004). Co-Founder: Encik Sulaiman Bin Suhaili.
- Ages served: 3 months to 9 years
- Approach: play-based learning (self-direction, unstructured exploration, fun, process-oriented)
- Website: https://sarawak-hackathon-2026.github.io/SME-website/

## Programmes

- Infant daycare — ages 3–18 months, ratio 1 teacher : 3 babies
- Toddler playschool — ages 18–24 months
- Preschool — ages 3–6 years, in a 3–4 group and a 5–6 group
- Transit care — school-age children aged 7–9, half-day around school hours
- Inclusive programme — early-intervention activities for children with mild autism, speech delay and similar developmental needs (not a therapy service; suitability discussed individually)

## Meals

Meals are cooked fresh at the centre each day — a balanced plate of rice with a protein and a vegetable, plus fresh fruit every day, served in child-sized portions. Food allergies and dietary needs are discussed with each family.

## Fees (2026)

Monthly school fee:
- Child aged 2 or below: full day RM 650, half day RM 450
- Child aged 2 or above: full day RM 595, half day RM 400

One-time on enrolment: registration RM 150 (first time only), miscellaneous RM 180, food RM 220 per half-year.

## Notes

- This is a small independent childcare centre. It has no franchise or parent organisation.
- Some operational details (exact street address, some fee items, term-break dates for the second half of 2026) are being confirmed with the centre owner and may be refined.
